description: The spec types the msearch request body only as application/x-ndjson, which the OpenAPI converter does not read, so the operations had no body member and could not send one. Add a required string body sent verbatim as application/x-ndjson, the way cloudflare vectorize/insertIndex-ndjson-body does. Source: the requestBodies.msearch entry of the official spec, and https://docs.opensearch.org/latest/api-reference/document-apis/bulk/ for the line format.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Searches as newline-delimited JSON (application/x-ndjson): a header line (`{"index":"logs"}` or `{}`), then the search body line, for each search. End the body with a newline.
